name: Fire29 broad short painted tongues
description: The new tongues are too thin and needle-like. Rebuild only the effect layers with BROAD SHORT flame strokes: each edge tongue has a22to32pixel-wide rooted base and maximum10to14pixel height in the256pixel canvas. Width must be at least twice height. A low irregular tapered crest with2soft unequal tips, never a thin upright triangle, needle, spike or rounded mound. Use the original soft mottled orange-yellow brush texture. Roots fixed along existing bright strokes; the outer contour gradually grows diagonally OUTWARD across the tile edge by10to18pixels then recedes. Do not slide, rotate, stretch the whole shape or draw a continuous border. Different gentle phases, visible but calm. Make the3inner tongues similarly broad and only4to7pixels high. Preserve the tile sprite. No flash, global glow pulse, detached flecks, jets, smoke or dark outline. Keep32frames,16fps,seamless loop.
